name: @sos-2/harness
description: SOS 2.0 Harness Contract (Work Order P5): the provider-neutral execution contract of spec/productization-execution-architecture.md section 9 as typed interfaces — identity(), capabilities(), createTask(), resumeTask(), pauseTask(), cancelTask(), workspace.read(), workspace.write(), shell.exec(), browser.open(), browser.interact(), git.status(), git.diff(), git.commit(), git.push(), git.createBranch(), git.createPullRequest(), artifacts.capture(), observations.emit(), events.subscribe() — where supported: unsupported capabilities are EXPLICIT through typed capability advertisement, never silent failure. The capability advertisement model mirrors the section 3 body advertisement list field-for-field (capabilities, isolation level, network policy, filesystem scope, browser/shell/git capability, runtime/cloud integrations, supported task lifecycle, evidence/artifact capture, cost and resource envelope). The advertisement is BINDING: isOperationAdvertised maps every section 9 operation onto the advertisement, and unsupported operations answer a typed UNSUPPORTED result. Harness/provider identity is NEVER SOS semantic identity (runtime identifier discipline consumed from @sos-2/runtime-contracts). Bodies are replaceable execution mechanisms, never authorities: the contract surface carries no authority fields at all.
